title: Entanglement and Bell States
summary: Tensor product, CNOT and the qubit ordering convention.
mission: Prepare the Bell state |Φ⁺⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2 on qubits 0 and 1.
hints: Start by putting qubit 0 in superposition with the Hadamard: qc.h(0). Note that, for now, both qubits still have vectors of length 1.
The CNOT gate flips the target when the control is 1. Use qubit 0 as the control and qubit 1 as the target: qc.cx(control, target).
The solution is qc.h(0) followed by qc.cx(0, 1). With the cursor on the CNOT line, the Bloch vectors shrink to the center.

prediction.question: The state (|00⟩ + |01⟩ − |10⟩ − |11⟩)/2 has four nonzero amplitudes. Is it entangled?
options: Yes: with all four amplitudes nonzero, the qubits are mixed together
No: it is a separable state, since a₀₀a₁₁ = a₀₁a₁₀
You cannot tell without measuring both qubits
prediction.explanation: Here a₀₀a₁₁ = (1/2)(−1/2) = −1/4 and a₀₁a₁₀ = (1/2)(−1/2) = −1/4: the product test passes. Indeed, the state is |−⟩ on qubit 1 and |+⟩ on qubit 0. Having several nonzero amplitudes does not mean entanglement.
